title: Syndicate
shortDescription: Syndicate is kept in GameAtlas's Super Nintendo Entertainment System shooter and strategy discovery path through frozen catalog organization and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced shooter and strategy option to the Super Nintendo Entertainment System discovery path.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Listed for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System shooter and strategy discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
